summary: BCB Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 18, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors voted to suspend quarterly cash dividends on common and preferred stock, and also suspend its 2026 Amended and Restated Dividend Reinvestment and Stock Purchase Plan. The suspension is effective immediately, as disclosed in an attached press release. No exact terms such as dividend amount or premium were stated. The filing does not mention any board recommendation, advisor, acquisition, or structural mechanics. This action likely reflects capital preservation amid economic uncertainties. No deal terms exist; there is no risk-arb angle, as this is a payout policy change, not a transaction.
